note: Python / uv version holds, read by `yolo update uv status|plan|apply`. A hold refuses a release above `maxMajor` or `maxVersion` and names the blocker; the pinned or capped state must stay in the pyproject it lives in (torch ==2.13.0, magika ~=0.6.1, markitdown). Entries with scope `transitive` explain packages the resolver keeps back because a parent caps them; they carry no manifest edit. `name` may end in `*`. Re-check on every `uv lock --upgrade`: remove the entry as soon as the blocker moves (yolo update uv status lists a cap without an entry as NO REASON). Advisory-only holds live in tools/config/deps/advisory-holds.json.

holds.name: torch
holds.reason: aphrody-train pins ==2.13.0 (cu130 index on Linux and Windows, PyPI elsewhere), the first release that fixes GHSA-rrmf-rvhw-rf47; the Windows CPU smoke (import torch.amp) and the embed/rerank ONNX export pass on it. The 2.14.0 Windows wheel failed to import torch.amp; re-run the Windows CPU smoke and the ONNX export on 2.14.x before lifting, and the cu130 index must carry the wheel.

holds.name: magika
holds.reason: markitdown hard-pins magika~=0.6.1 as a core dependency, so magika 1.x and markitdown cannot share an environment; classify.py supports both result shapes, a markitdown bump makes the upgrade a no-op.

holds.name: maturin
holds.reason: exact build-backend pin of the aphrody SDK (py/docs/sdk/native-build.md). The wheel is built in place from crates/ai/rag-python since 2026-10-05; 1.15.0 hardens the PEP 517 build-wheel path, so the cargo-built wheel needs a full requalification (uv build --wheel, tools/sdk/verify-wheel.py), which needs Cargo and stays with the lead's serialized build.

holds.name: torchvision
holds.reason: follows the torch 2.13.0 hold (torchvision 0.28 is the 2.13 release).

holds.name: triton
holds.reason: bound by the torch 2.13.0 hold (torch pins its triton release).

holds.name: nvidia-*
holds.reason: CUDA runtime wheels are pinned by the torch wheel that pulls them (2.13.0+cu130 in aphrody-train); they move with torch.

holds.name: cuda-*
holds.reason: CUDA runtime wheels are pinned by torch.

holds.name: huggingface-hub
holds.reason: docling-slim and sentence-transformers 6.1 require huggingface-hub <2; 2.x needs both to move.

holds.name: typer
holds.reason: docling-slim[standard] requires typer <0.27; moves with the next docling release.

holds.name: semchunk
holds.reason: docling-core[chunking] requires semchunk <4; moves with docling-core.

holds.name: mammoth
holds.reason: markitdown[docx] requires mammoth >=1.11,<1.12.dev0; moves with markitdown.

holds.name: websockets
holds.reason: google-genai requires websockets <17; moves with google-genai.

holds.name: fsspec
holds.reason: datasets 5.0.1 requires fsspec[http] <=2026.6.0; moves with the next datasets release.

holds.name: pydantic-core
holds.reason: pydantic 2.13.5 pins pydantic-core==2.46.5; the newer core ships with the 2.14 beta only.

holds.name: onnxruntime
holds.reason: magika 0.6.x requires onnxruntime <=1.20.1 on Windows (magika hold); onnxruntime 1.30 also ships no macOS x86_64 wheel, so the SDK lock forks per platform.
